comment: Translation qualification in functional requirement — A managed service cannot grant rights absent from the applicable terms. Apply the published WHO terms of use for ICD-11 content and software (https://icd.who.int/en/docs/ICD11-license.pdf), as revised from time to time, separately to content and software; verify the terms in force at publication. Translations, mappings and supplementary metadata require source-specific treatment. See C037; unpublished draft agreements are not substituted for operative terms.
